programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet S4E5 -Hog Wild

programme.title: 第5集 - 大小豬隻
programme.desc: 在科羅拉多州一般人可以合法地把豬當寵物飼養, 近年來由於所謂的新品種迷你豬, 茶杯豬或袖珍豬紛紛誕生, 養寵物豬也逐漸蔚為風潮, 很多人把小豬買回家, 以為每天餵食飼料但是豬卻不會長大, 殊不知小豬竟日漸肥胖, 轉眼之間就完全失控變成幾十公斤甚至上百斤的大肥豬, 於是又有越來越多人棄養豬隻, 在整個丹佛都會區, 流浪豬無人聞問更無收容所可去, 直到艾琳成立豬隻避風港這個非營利救援組織, 豬隻才脫離受虐和被棄養的命運, 終於有了一個安身之處, 這個救援組織的終極目標是要為豬隻找到最好的歸宿, 他們的策略之一就是要先為所有的豬隻絕育, 因為這樣豬隻到了發情期才不會逞兇鬥狠, 也比較容易成為大家能接受的寵物, 但是由於組織的資金完全來自於捐款, 他們的費用多半都用在豬隻的飼料和醫療上, 沒有多餘的經費來做豬隻傳染病的預防, 寵物計畫診所的貝爾醫師獲悉這個情況, 就主動前往豬隻收容所義務出診, 果真是名不虛傳的熱血獸醫師。

programme.desc: 問題少女艾莉莎·布斯塔曼特自稱「壞女孩」，並且表示想知道殺人是什麼感覺。她順從了這樣的好奇心，殺害了九歲的鄰居伊莉莎白·奧爾滕。

programme.title: Court Cam:6 E155

programme.title: 第155集
programme.desc: 遭控對兒童玩偶進行猥褻的男子在法庭上面對他的指控者；縱火犯從法官得知自己殺了九個人；多起命案的嫌犯在法庭行為不當等。

programme.title: Court Cam:6 E156
programme.desc: A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. An accused murderer attacks a courtroom deputy; a 9-year-old boy confronts his father's killer; and more.

programme.title: 第156集
programme.desc: 觀察最瘋狂的法庭時刻。受到指控的兇手攻擊警察；9歲的男孩面對殺害父親的兇手等。

programme.desc: A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A man drives a car off a cliff trying to elude police; a waitress gets flirtatious with deputies.

programme.title: 第8集 - 我要折扣！
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​一起看看全國各地一些最離奇的逮捕事件。一名男子為了逃避警方追捕，竟把車開下懸崖；一名女服務生則對副警長們大膽調情。

programme.title: My Strange Arrest:3 E7 -Meth Raccoon
programme.desc: A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. Police find a raccoon with a meth pipe in a woman’s car; a man is arrested while paying his taxes.

programme.title: 第7集 - 冰毒浣熊
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​一起看看全國各地一些最離奇的逮捕事件。警方在一名女子的車內發現一隻浣熊，旁邊還放著吸食安非他命的煙斗；另一名男子則在繳稅時遭到逮捕。

programme.title: First Blood:1 E1 -Ed Kemper: The Co-Ed Killer
programme.desc: This articulate and boastful killer is remembered for terrifying the coastal town of Santa Cruz in the early 1970s, but his desire to kill started when he was a young child fantasising about murder.

programme.title: 第1集 - 艾德蒙·肯珀：大學生殺手
programme.desc: 大家都記得，這名口齒伶俐又自吹自擂的殺手在1970年代初期震驚了海岸城鎮聖塔克魯茲，他在童年就對兇殺案著迷，殺人的欲望自此開始。

programme.title: Hoarders:14 E3 -Lia (Part A)
programme.desc: When Lia was ten, she became intrigued by her mother's many collectibles and started going to antique stores and estate sales with her and is where Lia suspects her hoarding compulsion originates.

programme.title: 第3集 - 莉雅（A部分）
programme.desc: 莉雅十歲時，就著迷於母親的許多收藏品，並開始與母親光顧古董店和居家用品特賣，莉雅懷疑自己的囤物癖源自於此。

programme.title: Hoarders:14 E4 -Lia (Part B)
programme.desc: Lia's hoarding went into overdrive when her three sons moved out, and Lia's husband, Ken, worked full time. After a severe blood infection, Lia realizes the extreme danger her home presents to her.

programme.title: 第4集 - 莉雅（B部分）
programme.desc: 莉雅在三個兒子搬出去後，囤物行為變本加厲，而莉雅的丈夫肯則從事全職工作。歷經嚴重的血液感染後，莉雅意識到，這是一間對自己極度危險的房子。

programme.title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks E1 -A Fatal Path

programme.title: 第1集 - 致命小徑

programme.title: City Confidential:9 E11 -Holy Terror In The Heartland

programme.desc: 法醫DNA專家瑪麗婭考拉松德溫格裡亞博士利用屍體的骨骼證明了一名男子的清白，並破解了被害人的身份。

programme.title: Partners In Crime:2 E6 -Insect Talk

programme.title: 第10集 - 殉職之日

programme.title: Sleeping With A Killer:2 E19 -Emmett Corrigan
programme.desc: A successful young lawyer’s seemingly perfect life unravels when a secret affair sparks a jealous confrontation that turns deadly in a quiet Idaho town.

programme.title: 第19集 - 埃米特・科里根
programme.desc: 一名事業有成的年輕律師，看似完美的人生因一段秘密婚外情而崩塌；妒火引發的對峙，最終在愛達荷州一個寧靜小鎮釀成命案。

programme.title: My Ghost Story Asia:1 E5
programme.desc: A man sees strange things on the deadly Karak Highway. Next, souls of dead children are kept in an amulet. Later, two men are spooked at a suicide spot.

programme.title: 第5集
programme.desc: 一名男子在以詭異車禍和鬧鬼事件而聞名的高速公路上看到了奇怪的東西；死去孩子的靈魂被困在一種名為古曼童的護身符中；兩名男子在一個自殺頻發地因遇鬼而受到了驚嚇。

programme.title: My Ghost Story Asia:1 E6

programme.title: 第6集

programme.desc: Police reopen the cold case murder of a young Marine who was killed in a hotel room and charge the woman who was with him at the time. Is she the mastermind behind his death or an innocent victim?

programme.desc: 警方重新調查年輕的海軍陸戰隊士兵在飯店房間遭到殺害的懸案，並起訴當時與他在一起的一名女子。她是這起命案背後的策劃者？還是無辜的受害者？

programme.title: Battle Ops S1E4 -Operation Rahat
programme.desc: A series on India's iconic military operations.

programme.title: 第4集 - 拉哈特行動
programme.desc: 2015年初, 葉門全境陷入動亂, 獲伊朗支持的反叛軍自北部一路進攻驅逐總統, 沙烏地阿拉伯則出兵援助現任政府, 發動空襲奪回南部地盤。印度與葉門素來有商業往來, 大批僑民因此受困於戰火中, 亟待政府救援。由於周遭地區尚有數百名印度籍旅外人士, 援救任務不可偏袒交戰的任一方, 以免平添變數。任務中動員了印度外交部、空軍、海軍、印度航空, 以及鐵道船舶部門, 以非洲之角的小國吉布地為基地, 透過海運與空運, 總計撤出4500名印度僑民、1500名各國人士, 堪稱建國以來數一數二的援救任務。

programme.title: Markets Of The World S1E1 -South Vietnam Cai Rang Floating Market

programme.title: 第1集 - 越南丐冷

programme.title: A Street Like This S1E6 -Mahabalipuram

programme.title: 第5集 - Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: 這集的發明出頭天中要介紹的四項發明有: 焦耳發電盒、智慧追蹤器、身體曲軸和碳纖維遙控飛機。首先登場的是焦耳發電盒, 但才剛開始測試, 發電盒卻意外冒煙, 因此布魯克和布萊恩給兩位發明人一點時間修復, 轉而測試智慧追蹤器, 追蹤器發名人宣稱是世上第一組基地台追蹤裝置, 什麼都可以追蹤, 布魯克和布萊恩選擇的測試方式是, 由布魯克帶著智慧追蹤器, 讓布萊恩帶著發明人搜尋, 結果雖然有點小誤差, 但基本算是順利找到；接著再回頭測試焦耳發電盒, 除了確如發明人所說不冒煙又寂靜無聲外, 他們從小型負載, 一直加大到用發電盒跳接發動汽車, 最後的確證明發明人所言不虛；接下來他們測試身體曲軸, 一開始他們對簡單怪異的造型無法理解, 實際操作後又不得不承認, 確實效果不錯, 只是仍然覺得操作上並不就手；最後他們測試碳纖維遙控飛機, 發明人強調飛機的碳纖維經過特別篩選, 具有抗摔能力, 所以即使因操作不當而發生碰撞, 也不會就此報銷, 布魯克和布萊恩測試後, 確認飛機抗摔耐撞, 只是以應用程式操作時並不好控制, 他們將測試結果向馬克回報, 在綜合焦點團體的意見後, 最後馬克選定投資智慧追蹤器。

programme.title: 第5集 - 多代同堂
programme.desc: 皮特這次接到來自德州瓦可市的委託案。麥鐸克斯家族有一大片牧場, 麥鐸克斯夫婦有5個孩子, 目前有6個孫兒女, 未來還會更多。他們發現在節日全家團圓時, 牧場上的房子空間不夠用了, 於是他們決定蓋一間樹屋。但是有句話說, 德州萬物皆大, 麥鐸克斯夫婦要求蓋一間至少能容納20人的大樹屋。這是皮特所蓋過最大的樹屋, 而工期只有一個月。皮特決定為他們蓋一間外形像似穀倉的傳統造型木屋, 但是屋內充滿現代感的設計, 並且找來全部的團隊一起投入這個大工程。

programme.title: Taiwan Made S1E3 -Sports, Shoes, Ocean Water, Tea And More

programme.title: 第3集 - Sports, Shoes, Ocean Water, Tea And More
programme.desc: 全世界知名品牌, 都尋求台灣專業製造商的協助, 使用立體模型技術, 設計前衛新潮的鞋類。一隻鞋的獨立組成部分可高達20種, 每一種都要符合特定的配色設計。他們要製作各式各樣的織物, 網布和填料。在球場外, 台灣有一位偉大的棒球無名英雄, 投身於製作完美的客製精品棒球套, 時間超過40年。手套的有四個獨立組件, 那些就是外皮、內裡、墊片和網布。台灣是世界上消耗茶葉很大的市場, 這家工廠位於台灣北部, 滿足當地品茶行家已有100年之久。在世界上許多地方, 茶葉一年採收兩次, 然而由於台灣的氣候溫和, 有些品種每年可以採收五次, 幾乎終年都有收穫。台灣海洋深層水公司, 是亞洲開發海洋水源最大的公司, 公司團隊從海洋深處開發水源, 製作各式各樣的保健品。有一家公司製作的電鍋, 數十年來已成為台灣的集體烹飪記憶, 電鍋到現在已經是有50多個年頭了, 它的基本的設計理念, 就是要讓男女老少都非常好用, 然後只需要一個按鍵。目前在台灣的大街小巷有1千4百萬輛機車左右, 台灣的氣候溫和, 車身很小的機車, 往往在全島是最快最經濟的代步工具。在高雄的這一家工廠, 準備進行每天的生產過程。

programme.desc: Dr. Ruby Rose and her emergency medical colleagues are like detectives and must follow the evidence to solve their mysteries.

programme.title: 第4集 - 拆解謎團
programme.desc: 本集節目中, 招牌護理急診中心再度迎來許多患者, 醫生就跟刑警一樣必須依照證據拆解謎團。包括吞食娃娃但依然活蹦亂跳的四歲孩童梅維絲。另外, 貝莉因撕裂傷掛急診, 醫生卻在傷口內取出不知何來的異物。喬許則是工作時, 右腳不慎遭到化學灼傷, 並有混凝土掉落傷口內, 他不得不趕緊轉往燙傷中心接受治療。還有諾爾走路不甚跌倒, 造成嘴唇撕裂傷, 偏偏嘴唇是最敏感和最難縫合的部位。

programme.title: How It's Made S12E24 -3-Wheel Electric Bikes, Skin Cream, Patio Heaters And Wood-Spoke Wheels
programme.desc: On this episode of How It's Made: three-wheel electric bikes, skin cream, patio heaters, and wood-spoke wheels.

programme.title: 第24集 - 電動三輪車
programme.desc: 1895年小奧格登波頓在美國註冊第一台電動三輪車的專利, 一百年之後它們成為全世界最受歡迎的電動交通工具, 電動三輪車蔚為風潮, 因為結合人體工學設計以及尖端機械工程。對付乾燥皮膚最好的方式就是塗抹潤膚乳, 它能活化皮膚細胞宛如一層保護屏障, 這一點在冬天特別重要, 抗癌藥物也會讓皮膚變乾硬, 因此擦乳液很重要。戶外暖器可以讓你在室外用餐即使天氣很冷, 並且在寒冷的夏天晚上增添暖意, 讓你在露台休憩的季節延長到秋天, 這種模式能讓熱氣從四面八方發散。早期車輛的輪胎有木輻和輪圈, 但到了1920年製造商開始採用比較持久的材質, 例如鐵和鋼, 目前木輻輪被用於經典車翻新, 製造商先生產包裹木輪胎的鋼鐵輪圈, 花16小時才打造出有懷舊風格的輪胎。

programme.title: Mega Engineering S1E4 -Underground City
programme.desc: Chicago - home to some of the world's most iconic skyscrapers. But the city's future may actually lie underground.

programme.desc: Chicago - home to some of the world's most iconic skyscrapers. But the city's future may actually lie underground.

programme.desc: As the men of NASA are closing in on the moonwalk, a fire breaks out in the Apollo 1 pressurized capsule, killing astronauts Gus Grissom, Ed White, and Roger Chaffee.

programme.title: 第3集 - 老鷹號登月
programme.desc: 1968年夏季, 雙子星計畫已經達成目標, 阿波羅計畫也已全力進行中, 太空總署將阿波羅8號的任務改為首次載人月球飛行。

programme.title: After Covid-19 S1E1 -After Covid19
programme.desc: The Covid19 virus has claimed more than 5.5 million lives in the past two years.

programme.title: 第1集 - After Covid19
programme.desc: 2020年新冠病毒席捲全球, 全球經濟遭受重創, 醫院變成了戰場。但這也是台灣運用科技讓社會進步的契機。在南投縣的台中榮民總醫院埔里分院, 急診醫師發現病人的中風疑慮, 馬上連聯60公里外的總院, 以Google眼鏡進行遠距會診, 並透過一站式的綠色通道, 讓病人直接前往醫療團隊所在的手術室, 爭取到寶貴的中風醫治時間。小智研發設計製造的輔仁大學醫院模組化單元, 採用負壓規格, 因此受污染的空氣不會洩漏到其他空間。台達電子的照明解決方案事業部, 投入新一代紫外線燈的研發, 為醫院提供了更好的消毒殺菌方法。

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Missing S1E6 -Lost Colony Of Roanoke
programme.desc: The Roanoke colony vanished without a trace, and centuries later, it remains one of history's greatest unsolved mysteries. But new evidence might at last reveal its fate.

programme.title: 第6集 - 消失的洛亞諾克村
programme.desc: 2013, 住在佛羅里達州的一名男子睡在自家的床上, 突然地板大開, 他被吸入地球內部, 活像是史蒂芬金的驚悚電影場景再現。地層瞬間消失, 這是一股大家都躲不掉的力量, 叫做「滲穴」。凡是干擾底土的密集人類活動, 都會引發滲穴, 小則一個房間, 大則如十九座足球場都有。美國五百年前的來了一群一百多人的殖民團隊, 到洛亞諾克落腳。當總督回英格蘭辦事, 三年後再回來, 卻發現人去樓空。考古學家藉由先進的儀器和空拍機, 發現這群人很可能是因為遇上乾旱而搬到別的島嶼。

programme.title: Extraordinary Stories Behind Everyday Things S1E3 -Pencil, Bundt Pan, Baseball Bat
programme.desc: Learn how a Louisville Slugger baseball bat can be chiseled from a piece of wood in 37 seconds.

programme.title: 第3集 - 鉛筆,球棒與烤模
programme.desc: 田納西州的鉛筆之都在全盛時期曾有多間工廠, 歷久不衰的馬斯格雷夫公司, 至今仍繼續傳承這個具有深遠歷史的產物；過去不被看好的蛋糕烤模, 在一次烘培比賽中脫穎而出後成為家家戶戶不可或缺的廚具；一窺職棒大聯盟御用球棒製造商的製作過程, 展現練就多年的好手藝, 並體會當地人對於棒球的熱愛。

programme.title: Extraordinary Stories Behind Everyday Things S1E4 -Jelly Bean, Neon Sign, Snowboard
programme.desc: Discover how a California manufacturer from 1869 makes jelly beans from the inside out, how a company in Seattle carries on the electrifying tradition of neon signs.

programme.title: 第4集 - 雷根糖,霓虹燈與滑雪板
programme.desc: 吉利貝出產許多種糖果和甜食, 其中最受歡迎的就是你我都愛的雷根糖。在糖果工廠, 各種風味的糖漿灌入模具、裹上糖粉, 形成具有嚼勁的糖心, 最後披上一層糖衣, 閃亮甜蜜的雷根糖等著你來品嘗。復古的霓虹燈, 不論白天黑夜, 都為美國大街小巷增添光彩, 形成一種獨特風情。西岸霓虹1985年在西雅圖發跡, 玻璃、氣體和電流的化學反應造就炫彩奪目的霓虹藝術, 這項技藝永不過時。從白雪靄靄的山頭向下衝刺, 腳上踩的滑雪板結合了衝浪板及傳統滑雪板設計而成。採用頂級木材製成的木芯, 工匠嚴謹的做工和外觀與性能兼具的設計, 「永無夏日」滑雪板成了每個滑雪玩家的夢幻逸品。

programme.title: Heavy Metal Task Force S2E5 -Jumbo Javelin, Colossus And Menzi Muck
programme.desc: A heavy-lift ship delivers one of the largest pieces of cargo ever.

programme.title: 第5集 - Jumbo Javelin, Colossus And Menzi Muck
programme.desc: A heavy-lift ship delivers one of the largest pieces of cargo ever.

programme.title: How The Universe Works S10E3 -Dark History Of Earth
programme.desc: Earth's history is marked by one cosmic disaster after another, forging the path of human evolution.

programme.title: 第3集 - 地球黑暗史
programme.desc: 地球遊走在生存與毀滅之間, 一個又一個的災難在地球身上留下歲月痕跡, 但毀滅的同時也創造了新生, 一切端看運氣。

programme.title: Unexplained And Unexplored S1E5 -Mystery Of The American Maya
programme.desc: New evidence suggests the Maya civilization did not suddenly vanish, but instead, that they survived and resettled in the United States.

programme.title: 第5集 - 馬雅文明之謎
programme.desc: 馬雅帝國興盛了4600年, 這個帝國版圖含括了墨西哥東南到宏都拉斯, 但就在西元700到900年, 馬雅城市瓦解並被棄置。主持人跟隨德勒斯登抄本的密碼地圖線索, 尋找馬雅人逃離猶加敦移居美國的證據, 一路來到佛州西岸, 結晶河遺址, 以及羅伯茲島, 找出各種文物, 以及可能是馬雅階梯金字塔位置的資訊, 證明這世上一大高度文明, 可能就在佛州重建帝國。

programme.title: Invent It Rich S2E5 -Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: Experts Brook & Brian help Marc vet four big claims: a carbon fiber crash-proof drone; a fitness device using centripetal force for a total body workout.

programme.title: 第5集 - Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: 這集的發明出頭天中要介紹的四項發明有: 焦耳發電盒、智慧追蹤器、身體曲軸和碳纖維遙控飛機。首先登場的是焦耳發電盒, 但才剛開始測試, 發電盒卻意外冒煙, 因此布魯克和布萊恩給兩位發明人一點時間修復, 轉而測試智慧追蹤器, 追蹤器發名人宣稱是世上第一組基地台追蹤裝置, 什麼都可以追蹤, 布魯克和布萊恩選擇的測試方式是, 由布魯克帶著智慧追蹤器, 讓布萊恩帶著發明人搜尋, 結果雖然有點小誤差, 但基本算是順利找到；接著再回頭測試焦耳發電盒, 除了確如發明人所說不冒煙又寂靜無聲外, 他們從小型負載, 一直加大到用發電盒跳接發動汽車, 最後的確證明發明人所言不虛；接下來他們測試身體曲軸, 一開始他們對簡單怪異的造型無法理解, 實際操作後又不得不承認, 確實效果不錯, 只是仍然覺得操作上並不就手；最後他們測試碳纖維遙控飛機, 發明人強調飛機的碳纖維經過特別篩選, 具有抗摔能力, 所以即使因操作不當而發生碰撞, 也不會就此報銷, 布魯克和布萊恩測試後, 確認飛機抗摔耐撞, 只是以應用程式操作時並不好控制, 他們將測試結果向馬克回報, 在綜合焦點團體的意見後, 最後馬克選定投資智慧追蹤器。

programme.desc: Goodson's All-Terrain loses a key crewmember when Bo faces a life threatening illness and is put on a ventilator. The family rallies for a benefit on his behalf.

programme.title: Faster With Finnegan S2E4 -Drag Race Mustang Vs. Andrade's Malibu!
programme.desc: Last season, the guys put John Andrade Jr. in a tiny truck and beat him in a mud drag race with the Dirt Track Camaro.

programme.title: 第4集 - 安查德再挑戰
programme.desc: 路上最殺系列節目是仙境直線加速賽道的常客。費尼根等人一直都曉得, 起跑線旁的棚子裡停了一輛殺肉用的福特野馬, 除了引擎外, 所有能摘下的東西幾乎都給人挪用光了, 車上還遍布泥蜂與胡蜂窩。本節目的3人組決定拯救這輛鐵馬, 挑戰1萬美元的低預算, 目標是跟直線加速名駕駛和名車比拚。一切成敗全都繫於引擎翻修的結果上。

programme.title: Airplane Repo S2E3 -Repo Rat Race
programme.desc: Ken and Danny must race to beat out rival repo men on the biggest yacht heist of their careers.

programme.title: 第3集 - 遊艇爭奪戰
programme.desc: 凱文與蓋瑞在明尼蘇達州搜尋價值15萬的水上飛機: 派珀超級巡航機。他們趁天剛破曉, 立刻衝去奪回飛機, 但引擎聲吵醒持有槍枝的債務人, 馬上坐水上摩托車追出來。幸好飛機即時爬升到空中, 順利完成任務。丹尼與肯在邁阿密尋找價值300萬的聖汐曼哈頓號遊艇, 卻發現現場還有別組討債人馬, 他們搶先摸黑溜進遊艇裡, 可惜潮水太低不能立即開動, 只能等到早上。在陰錯陽差之下, 另組討債同業幫丹尼把遊艇拖出債務人的碼頭。丹尼趕緊找機會割斷繩子, 全速前進去領取30萬的報酬。麥克耗費兩個月時間追蹤價值400萬的李爾噴射機60, 他與副駕駛員亨利聯手在機庫製造停電並引開所有維修人員, 卻發現飛機沒電了, 最後麥克靠著小電池與地面電源機串聯, 才成功發動噴射機。

programme.title: Texas Metal's Loud And Lifted S1E6 -Cummins Diesel In A Lambo
programme.desc: 1 Way Diesel Performance put a twin-turbo Cummins into a 2004 Lamborghini Gallardo. Mod Mafia helps 'Unspeakable' star Nathan Graham with his SHERP.

programme.title: 第6集 - 柴油引擎藍寶堅尼
programme.desc: 在萬威柴油車廠, 切斯等人要繼續完成這輛2004年的藍寶堅尼。

programme.title: Misfit Garage S1E5 -Furious '65 Fastback Part 1
programme.desc: The Misfits open house is shut down by Richard Rawlings.Thomas picks up a rare Ford Torino Cobra. Without a project car, the team hastily buys a '65 Mustang fastback .

programme.title: 第5集 - 稀有快背車上集
programme.desc: 湯瑪斯負責替車坊買車, 快快整理, 轉手獲利。這輛他物色了十年卻依然買不到的車子, 這回他帶湯姆去看, 竟然車主願意割愛, 碰巧湯姆也對此車情有獨鍾, 只是雖然答應車主會好好翻新這輛車, 湯瑪斯卻又忍不住找朋友來看車, 想要快速轉手獲利。另一方面為了要彌補湯姆的失望。他們又去看了一輛林肯, 但是誤打誤撞, 反而買到野馬快背, 成為全車徹底翻新的選擇。

programme.title: Shifting Gears With Aaron Kaufman S1E4 -Big Rig Gig
programme.desc: Aaron Kaufman takes on a new challenge to build a Semi-Race Truck. He brings on experts in the field of Semi-Truck racing, Bob and his son.

programme.title: 第4集 - 卡車制霸
programme.desc: 艾倫考夫曼幫其他人打造車子已經太久, 現在要走不同的方向, 在他的新車坊弧光裝配, 他正在設計副廠貨卡零件, 打造他一直以來都想做的獨特車輛。艾倫也從全美各地欽點了最棒的造車師傅加入團隊, 而打造這些特製車, 將挑戰他們在各個層面的技能和經驗, 而當車子完成, 他們都將拿來一衣測試。這回艾倫把握住千載難逢的機會, 買入拖車頭, 要正面迎戰爆炸性的障礙, 角逐拖車頭賽車大激戰。他們沒人改過這麼大塊頭的車, 肯定是全新的學習陣痛期, 所以他們找來箇中好手相助, 而工作之餘免不了也要忙裡偷閒, 而這回是直衝上天際。

programme.title: Smoked S1E1 -You Bet Your Butt
programme.desc: Texas beef specialist Ernest Servantes and Georgia pork expert Robby Royal have turned to Myron Mixon to settle their rivalry once and for all.

programme.title: 第1集 - 冠軍的對決
programme.desc: 喬治亞的豬肉大王羅比, 到德州, 與當地的烤肉名家恩斯特進行一場三回合的對抗賽。

programme.title: 100 Miles From Nowhere S1E3 -No Way Out
programme.desc: The trio heads to Arizona to battle harsh winds, frigid temperatures, endless sand and breathtaking, but deadly slot canyons.

programme.title: 第3集 - 無路可退
programme.desc: 麥特和兩個死黨丹尼與布雷克要挑戰位在猶他州與亞利桑那州之間, 地形多變的廣闊沙漠峻谷, 終點是白口袋山。

programme.title: Street Customs Berlin S1E4 -The Style Police
programme.desc: Ryan and Alex are approached by a modeling agent who wants to put up a big fashion show at the West Coast Customs Berlin shop.

programme.title: 第4集 - 時尚警察
programme.desc: 艾利斯在夜店碰到一位客戶亞歷斯范海森, 他經營模特兒經紀公司, 並提議跟柏林廠合作舉辦今年時尚週的搖滾時尚夜, 地點就利用柏林廠, 萊恩跟艾利斯同意, 並決定用改裝警車來做為這次合作改裝車輛的主題。艾利斯在柏林附近看到一輛雪佛蘭老爺車, 提議用它來改裝成時尚夜警車, 不過, 乍看之下, 萊恩簡直嚇了一大跳, 對還沒有經驗的柏林新手團隊而言, 這項改裝工程是一項大挑戰。尤其是, 在改裝過程中, 萊恩邀請日本老友哈地齊, 與艾利斯和梅根一同前往埃森車展, 看看歐洲目前最新的車款, 不過, 在柏林零下16度的低溫下, 留在廠裡的團隊卻進度遲緩, 艾利斯回來發現, 簡直怒不可遏, 萊恩也決定從加州請來大丹, 好好整頓一下柏林廠的紀律, 時尚夜當晚, 改裝警車能夠如期完成嗎?

programme.title: Fourwheeler S3E1 -All-Aluminum Defender Part 1
programme.desc: Ian starts work on a custom all-aluminum Land Rover Defender that sits on top of a Jeep JK chassis.

programme.title: 第1集 - 全鋁製捍衛者1
programme.desc: 荒原路華捍衛者D90是熱門越野車, 但電系、傳動系統和傳動軸都不如吉普車, 因此伊恩決定自創自己的版本。他結合副廠捍衛者1-10車身與吉普JK底盤, 搭配康明斯R2.8柴油引擎、名廠TR4050變速箱, 以及吉普JK德納44魯比孔後軸, 做出滾動式底盤。

programme.title: Fourwheeler S3E2 -All-Aluminum Defender Part 2
programme.desc: Work continues on the aluminum Defender. This time, Ian gets more of the drivetrain in place and gets the project sitting on its new wheels and tires.

programme.title: 第2集 - 全鋁製捍衛者2
programme.desc: 伊恩持續試安裝鋁製荒原路華捍衛者110。他處理油箱配置, 清理原本裝汽油的油箱, 以免影響柴油引擎, 他把內建電動燃油泵拆掉, 交給引擎的機械式燃油泵抽油。他升級煞車系統, 換上較大的碟盤和卡鉗。他安裝電瓶以及電瓶管理系統, 使充電更順利。

programme.title: Speed Is The New Black S2E4 -Blazing Fast F-100
programme.desc: When a military veteran and retiring firefighter pitches Noah on his dream truck, the shop rallies around the build and turns this 70's pickup into an autocross bomb.

programme.title: 第4集 - 追風F-100
programme.desc: 諾亞開設經典車工坊, 讓車子好看, 對他們來說是一定要的, 讓車子性能好, 則是他們的專長。在經典車工坊這兒, 有遠見的工匠大師團隊, 經手各式各樣的車, 改造成為量身特製的高性能勁車, 你要贏得車展就另請高明, 若你要贏得車展又能衝第一, 來找他們就對了。本集一位軍人英雄, 要讓他的美國經典車, 在道路賽道上盡情奔馳。還有無死角的週末夜兜風車, 得到經典車工坊的加持。

programme.title: Mud Madness S2E9 -The 100000 Controversy
programme.desc: Four drivers are fighting for the $100,000 prize in the Mud Cup's final race, but a shocking controversy threatens the championship.

programme.title: 第9集 - 十萬獎金之爭
programme.desc: 四名車手在泥地盃最終賽中爭奪十萬美元獎金, 然而一起爆炸性的爭議威脅著整個冠軍賽的結果。

programme.title: Swamp Loggers S2E5 -Crisis Of Faith
programme.desc: Goodson's All-Terrain loses a key crewmember when Bo faces a life threatening illness and is put on a ventilator. The family rallies for a benefit on his behalf.

programme.desc: Keisha is apprehensive about the team's next zombie, which may hurt the potential resale. Add to that a bad foundation and the discovery of termites, this potential flip seems more like a potential flop.

programme.desc: In traditional Taiwanese cuisine, pig liver was regarded as a luxurious ingredient used in nutrition-boosting dishes. Legendary Chef A-fa showcases the gastronomic potential of pig liver.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E21
programme.desc: Fifteen MasterChef contestants must cook something connected to their heritage. The top dish will win a $10,000 prize courtesy of Ancestry, while the bottom dish will send its maker home.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E22
programme.desc: In MasterChef's most notorious team challenge, four teams will navigate the chaos of the Team Relay to compete for a chance to cook for Immunity.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E23
programme.desc: Guided by MasterChef alumnus Justine Schofield, four contestants put their French techniques to the test for a chance to win a coveted Immunity pin.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E24
programme.desc: It's Perfect Pairings week and today the contestants must choose between two Mystery Boxes: one set by MasterChef legend Matt Sinclair and one by Peli's head chef Daniel Dobra, aka ‘Dobbers'.

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E25
programme.desc: In the second episode of perfect pairs week, the home cooks must select one of five classic flavour pairings as they go head-to-head in an elimination cook-off.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S2E9 -Life Lesions
programme.desc: Dr. Tolson learns how to help Dr. Lee treat Mary Beth's bumpy, mysteriously changing face lesions. An unexpected medical emergency sends Dr. Lee to the hospital. Dr. Ortiz steps in to help Kathy.

programme.title: Living With My Mother's Killer
programme.desc: Still reeling from the tragic murder of her mother years ago, Mara forgives the man who killed her and allows him to work on her property, only to find that what's past is not always past.

programme.title: The Neighbor Who Saw Too Much
programme.desc: A grounded teen becomes convinced that her hot new neighbour is actually a dangerous killer. When no-one else believes her, she takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E3 -Heat
programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E4 -Ice
programme.desc: Trek to the planet’s quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E5 -Grasslands
programme.desc: Explore one of Earth’s most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E3 -Change in the Air
programme.desc: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E4 -Hunkering Down
programme.desc: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumn’s final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E1 -Bound By Blood
programme.desc: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealand’s South Island. Face forest penguins’ feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E2 -Life in Dark Water
programme.desc: Learn how winter’s arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E3 -Age of Independence
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E1 -Deadly Intruders
programme.desc: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E2 -Snake Face Off
programme.desc: Launch into spring’s snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E3 -Reptile Runabout
programme.desc: Weave through Queensland’s coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E4 -Hot and Bothered
programme.desc: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowner's pets.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E5 -Chasing Scales
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E6 -Home Invasion
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E1 -Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E2 -Double Trouble
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S2E1 -Start of Trauma Season
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S2E2 -Operation Pelican
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who’s swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S2E3 -Gutsy Koala
programme.desc: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tim’s squirrel glider knee surgery.

programme.title: Go Buster S4E1 -Learning to Do the Right Thing!
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns to do the right thing! When Buster accidentally breaks the class flower, he panics & tries to cover it up, but soon learns that telling the truth is always the best thing to do. Then, when he & Daddy spot a steam train speeding out of control, they know they have to do the right thing! They race after the train & save the day! From cleaning up his toys to helping a puppy, Buster is always trying to do the right thing.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage S5E5 -Gecko & Grandma's Artsy Prix
programme.desc: Race in the Artsy August Grand Prix with Gecko! First, help fix Miles' suspension on the track. Then, stop a runaway car wash, help Carrie see after a paint spill, and blast off on an imaginary space adventure with the team.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage S7E1 -From Waterfalls to Outer Space!
programme.desc: Join Gecko on his biggest adventures yet, from waterfalls to outer space! First, when Grandma's caravan rolls into a river & heads for a waterfall, Gecko must perform a daring chase to save her! Then, a lovely day at the beach becomes perilous when some vehicles get caught in the tide, requiring a helicopter rescue. The adventure blasts off as the Mechs accidentally launch their homemade spaceship to the moon & need to use solar power to get home!

programme.title: ARPO S2E1 -Squirrel Trouble & Other Wacky Problems!
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble & other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably & when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: ARPO S3E2 -The Ultimate Arpo vs Squirrel Showdown!
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo & his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie & tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo & takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: ARPO S4E1 -Crazy Competitions & Robot Malfunctions!
programme.desc: It's a day of crazy competitions & robot malfunctions! First, a friendly competition in the park turns into a wild go-kart race between Arpo & his rival, Nannybot! Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire. A toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably all over the backyard, & a malfunctioning birthday present massage chair chases him & Daniel around the house! From boomerang target practice to a building block showdown, the chaos never stops!

programme.title: ARPO S1E2 -Causing Chaos All Over Town!
programme.desc: Arpo & Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes & a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E9 -JJ's Favorite Songs & Stories!

programme.desc: When Adam and Eva break up after ten years, Adam thinks the breach was caused by one trivial incident, but Eva knows she's already forgiven Adam 77 times! Sweethearts since law school, Adam changed professions to start a Thai boxing studio and gradually became indifferent to Eva. Seemingly petty matters, like forgetting she hates raisin cookies, become the catalyst for her moving out and changing her Facebook status to 'single'. Despondent, Adam has a drunken tryst with his student, Mandy. Adam gains new insight after accidentally discovering Eva's private journal. Entitled '77 Heartbreaks', the title refers to the philosophy that 'forgiving someone 7 times isn't enough; 70 x 7 times is too much; so go ahead and forgive 77 times!' Reading it makes Adam realize his love. But what can he do to win her back? And what secret is contained in the journal's torn-out last page? He rushes to Eva and melts her heart by recounting their happy memories. When Eva tells him Heartbreak #77

programme.title: Broker

On a rainy night, they steal the baby 'Woosung,' who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

programme.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish
programme.desc: A fateful encounter between average college student Tsuneo and a wheelchair-bound dreamer, Josee, who spends her time reading and painting. As Tsuneo is swept up by her dreams, Josee takes another chance at facing reality.

programme.title: Ladies Market
programme.desc: A 11-year-old illegal immigrant, Tung, stays and lives in the Ladies' Market with T-shirt seller, Fai. One day, Tung rescued Yan who is kidnapped. Two of them bumped into van driver Pui Yi and gangster Ho...

programme.title: Annapurna

It is already past noon but they continue a casual conversation about their past relationships while hiking along trails. Kang Hyun reminisces about the bittersweet memories of his exes ‘Anna' and ‘Eun Chae', while Sun Woo regrets treating his ex ‘Eun Jung' badly and blames his immaturity in the past relationship with ‘Pureum'.Kang Hyun and Sun Woo come across different people along the trail. They pass by a good-looking woman in tight leggings who instantly capture their eyes. They also come across a middle-aged man who gives disappointing hiking tips, which make them feel hopeless. ‘Anna' and ‘Pureum' incarnate our bygone lovers who we once strongly admired but failed to reach.Though hiking is as tough as life can be, it can also bring you joy because some people come into our lives and make us happy. programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Past and present survival of the common man in the big city - ups and downs, laughters and tears... In 1970s Hong Kong, rapacious landlords try to evict 72 tenants but sworn brothers Ha Kugn and Shek Kin help the group of 72 defeat the landlord and landlady and coincidentally rescue Pinky from a planned forced marriage. When both sworn brothers fall for Pinky and propose to her, she flips a coin 'heads or tails' and Ha wins her hand in marriage. The sworn brothers become sworn enemies and Shek's hatred fuels intense rivalry against Ha in business dealings ranging from the manufacture of plastic flowers to the selling of stinky bean curd. Even after 40 years they continue to clash and in 2010 they are in keen competition selling electronics appliances in Sai Yeung Choi Street, Mongkok, the busiest street in the city and still home to the 72 tenants. programme.title: Love On A Diet
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes an fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Turn Our Pages
programme.desc: Successful film ‘Time Still Turns The Pages' not only won four awards for new director Nick Cheuk, but also surprised the team by receiving enormous response from the society. In this interview, Nick mentions his inspiration behind the story and talks with the film's leading actress Rosa Maria Velasco about unforgettable scenes especially the outstanding performance of young actor Sean Wong. Lastly, they have the hearts set on the film to encourage the audience to get better at expressing and channeling own feelings.

programme.title: Acting's No Kidding: Time Still Turns The Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng looks back to his repressed childhood memories, as he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. He strives hard to prevent another tragedy from happening, meanwhile facing a series of family problems, his wife is divorcing him, and his father is dying.

programme.title: Baogu Select Music X Microfilm E263 -T. F. E.
programme.desc: 'T.F.E.' is a micro-movie blending music, sci-fi, and comedy. Security guard Chak accidentally drinks an alien beverage called 'T.F.E.,' gaining superpowers and becoming a community hero-but also attracting extraterrestrial visitors and chaos. Through clashes and cooperation with strict supervisor Lam, he discovers his true purpose. With humor and absurdity, the film explores belonging, growth, and the power of music, ending on an imaginative and heartfelt note.

programme.title: The White Dragon
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman...

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Chan Hing Kai
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: The Magic Crane
programme.desc: While the world of martial arts is in probably the most peaceful period for a long while, the Tien Lung Tribe suddenly emerges with a strong military presence as if it were to conquer the warring society. As its presence begin to stir up everyone in the scene, the Court decides to order the leader of the Six Fan Gates – Cho Hung to gather the ten most esteemed tribes for a conference in an attempt to prevent any chaos or unnecessary warfare in the community...

programme.title: Thou Shall Not Commit
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed...

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Chin Siu Ho
programme.desc: Being a well-known martial art movie star, Chin Siu Ho talks about his stories and personal feelings from such long journey. When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode!

programme.title: Mr Fortune
programme.desc: Toy designer Yau is always bullied by boss and ex-girlfriend. One day, Yau runs into a beautiful but rebellious girl named Ching, who tells him she is the target of triad harassment. Yau is determined to help her, and he resigns from his job at the encouragement of Ching. The two take low-pay jobs at a fast-food chain, and gradually fall in love with each other, but their relationship is threatened when Ching's true identity as the daughter of a tycoon is exposed...

programme.title: Lucky Stars Go Places
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: Charismatic Cecilia Yip: Chaos By Design
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends...

programme.title: The Seventh Curse
programme.desc: Yuan Chen-ha saves Betsy from being sacrificed by the wicked priest in Thailand, but is stricken with seven blood curses. Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies...

programme.title: The Cat
programme.desc: One night, disturbing noise comes from an upstairs flat. Lee Don decides to go up and caution the noise-makers. He sees there are an old man, a young girl and a black cat. But Lee Don discovers that the flat is completely deserted on the next day. A cat's innards, however, are left behind. Lee Don tells this to Wisely, famous for his adventures. Wisely gets suspicious. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. An outer space killer takes possession of a police officer's body and tries to wipe them, including Wisely...

programme.desc: 高冷孤僻的企業繼承人顧榮儼然是個“傲嬌公子”，而看似軟萌文靜的少女蘇靜靜實則武藝不凡。一場意外讓“元氣少女”蘇靜靜與“不食人間煙火”的顧榮產生交集，還成為他的貼身保鏢。性格、習慣大相徑庭的兩人不得不開啟室友生活，在追求人生目標中攜手蛻變與成長……

programme.title: Royal Rumours E1
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E1 -Aftermath
programme.desc: Miguel's fighting for his life, Robby's missing, and Daniel and Johnny's reputations are in tatters as the community reacts to the West Valley brawl.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E2 -Nature Vs Nurture
programme.desc: Daniel and Johnny team up to find Robby. Miguel faces an uncertain future. Kreese tries to bring Tory back to Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E3 -Now You're Gonna Pay
programme.desc: Daniel's tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguel's surgery.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E4 -The Right Path
programme.desc: Following an important meeting in Japan, Daniel revisits Mr. Miyagi's hometown in Okinawa. Johnny attempts to reconnect with Robby.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E5 -Miyagi-Do
programme.desc: In Okinawa, Daniel spends time with an old friend - and an old enemy, who has much to teach him. The dueling dojos' rivalry comes to a nasty head.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E6 -King Cobra
programme.desc: Miguel helps Johnny craft the perfect social media message. Kreese scouts new recruits while Daniel and Amanda try to shut down Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E7 -Obstculos
programme.desc: Daniel spends some father-daughter time with a traumatized Sam. Johnny plans to form a new karate dojo but struggles to come up with a cool name.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E8 -The Good, The Bad And The Badass
programme.desc: Informed that this year's All Valley Karate Tournament is being canceled, the three competing sensei attend a city council meeting to save it.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E9 -Feel The Night
programme.desc: It's Christmastime in the Valley, and romance is in the air. Daniel and Miguel find unexpected common ground, and the Cobra Kai recruits go on a mission.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3E10 -December 19
programme.desc: Old wounds begin to heal at a country club Christmas party, but a brutal assault by Kreese's students leads to new betrayals and alliances.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E1 -Let's Begin
programme.desc: Johnny and Daniel combine dojos but their opposing styles immediately clash. Kreese tries to persuade a former partner to rejoin him at Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E2 -First Learn Stand
programme.desc: Johnny picks up defensive strategies while Daniels learns how to go on the offensive. Amanda confronts Tory. New kid Kenny is bullied at school.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E3 -Then Learn Fly
programme.desc: Kenny tries to become a student of Cobra Kai with some encouragement from Robby, while Johnny urges Sam to take a leap of faith - in herself.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E4 -Bicephaly
programme.desc: Kreese brings Terry back to Cobra Kai, but his former partner is not interested in repeating history. Johnny grows envious of Daniel mentoring Miguel.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E5 -Match Point
programme.desc: Johnny and Daniel's dojo - and their fragile alliance - teeter on the brink of collapse when they agree to a winner-takes-all sensei showdown.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E6 -Kicks Get Chicks
programme.desc: A major change to the upcoming tournament sends Johnny scrambling to find a new recruit for Eagle Fang. Tory must ask a favor of the LaRussos.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E7 -Minefields
programme.desc: Daniel invites Anthony to join Miyagi-Do and discovers he doesn't know his son as well as he thought. Miguel learns the truth about Johnny and Carmen.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E8 -Party Time
programme.desc: Miguel and Sam are excited about attending the junior prom until another couple unexpectedly shows up. Terry lures Johnny to a familiar location.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E9 -The Fall
programme.desc: The annual All Valley Karate Tournament kicks off as several competing dojos vie for the grand championship - and settle some personal scores.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S4E10 -The Rise
programme.desc: The tournament comes to a shocking end, with the aftermath leaving its participants reeling - and two champions facing uncertain futures.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5E1 -Long, Long Way From Home
programme.desc: Daniel's new ally-turned-housemate tests Amanda's patience. Miguel searches for his father in Mexico. Terry starts to transform Cobra Kai.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5E2 -Mole
programme.desc: Chozen and Daniel hatch a risky plot against Terry. In Mexico, Robby and Johnny look for Miguel, who discovers the truth about his dad.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S5E3 -Playing With Fire
programme.desc: Another enemy from Daniel's past resurfaces. After a spa day and some soul-searching, Sam comes to a decision about her future with Miguel.
